verdict.rationale: Project spaces are a fair question for a personal AI agent, so the axis applies. The pack shows no project or space feature that groups chats and files under shared context and instructions. What it does document is adjacent: one shared memory across surfaces, reading Linear projects, publishing a web page for a project, and general help with the projects a user is carrying.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
